source_quote:
The "Best Practice Recommendations" text in Section 9.1 is redundant with the subsequent tables. It is recommended to delete the text and keep only the tables.
Section 9.2 is missing from the document structure. If no model-specific tuning is involved, a feature matrix table along with a link to the public performance tuning documentation should be provided for reference. It is recommended to add this section.
According to the template requirements, the FAQ section (Chapter 10) should only include model-specific issues. The document should not include the generic issues "HCCL port conflicts" or "OOM or unstable startup." It is recommended to delete these.
The description in Chapter 7 — "Here are two accuracy evaluation methods." — does not match the actual content of the section. It is recommended to revise the description.
You can adjust the header fields referring to the changes in PR: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/10337/changes.

rule.description: 模型文档的 FAQ 章节应仅包含该模型特有的问题，不应包含通用问题（如 HCCL 端口冲突、OOM 等），通用问题应放在通用 FAQ 文档中。
